components.text: Traps an Original in a closed ring of mountain ash for the whole rite. At the end the target and their whole branch leave that Original's line, never the Original's whole line.
Only a witch type can work it, under a lunar eclipse. Needs the target's bound Sire's Blood; the target must be online here and not an Original.

Draw the ring first, inside the chalk and 6 blocks from the centre (a ring closing within 8 blocks works). The Original stands on the centre inside it, downed, dying or desiccated, and must be of the target's line.

The rite lasts 30 seconds (a server setting) and is checked twice a second. A broken ring, an Original who escapes, the eclipse ending or the caster or target leaving ends it with no effect, and the ingredients are spent.
